runs.summary: I checked T-414 again and it stays blocked: the Apps Script still hasn't been redeployed.

decisions.decision: Keep T-414 as the single input task for the redeploy, and update its ask to carry both routes. At the start of every run, check whether Claude in Chrome is connected on profile 'Browser 1' (adi@growthclub.org). If it is, do the redeploy yourself, typing no password: paste workshop-plan/ops/apps-script/Code.gs, then Manage deployments > edit > New version > Deploy (same URL). Also GET the exec URL health each run. Once it lists tier_qualifier, whoever redeployed, close T-414, post one tier_qualifier probe row and confirm it lands in the Work Tracker. Then publish the /workshop/join and /masterclass/success/join qualifier to the tantra-workshop-live mirror, rerun app/scripts/probe-tier-qualifier.mjs, and finish T-409 with evidence. Do not reroute answers through another form key, and build nothing else around this.
decisions.why: decisions/T-409 (2026-10-12): no ~/.clasprc.json, no Apps Script scope in any token, no adi@ Google credential in ~/.config/tantra/keys. Memory funnel-live-wiring: Google refused the deploy from boards@. T-409 log: Browser 1 not connected.
